messages:
Ravi Kumar: Heads-up: autopilot rolled v2.9.7 -> v2.9.8 in EU yesterday night during the 00:30 change window. Seeing a token-usage spike and p50 regressions on embeddings path.
Evelyn Park: I have the observability graphs. tokens/sec up ~18% and p50 +40ms for embeds-eu. Not a full outage but cost impact is real.
Liam O'Connor: deploy-bot posted an auto-fallback suggestion earlier?
deploy-bot: AUTOFALLBACK: cost_metric_above_threshold AND p50_latency > threshold -> ACTION: recommend partial rollback for "eu-central" to previous model variant. Auto action suppressed due to Dedicated-tenants flag. Manual approval required. :information_source:
Ravi Kumar: Because Dedicated customers are opted-in to controlled rollouts, autopilot didn't flip. We need to decide ASAP: manual rollback for EU only or force auto?
Evelyn Park: prefer manual so we can craft release notes for customers. Also need to call out billing to affected tenants if cost persists.
Liam O'Connor: agree. Suggest pinning v2.9.7 for eu-central, create a temporary traffic-split so shared customers see minimal disruption.
Ravi Kumar: command to pin (ops runbook):
```
releasectl pin-version --region=eu-central --version=2.9.7 --scope=region --reason="quantization-cost-regression"
```
Then shift traffic:
```
releasectl traffic shift --region=eu-central --from=2.9.8 --to=2.9.7 --weight=100 --wait=30s
```
Dry-run first.
Evelyn Park: I'll draft the internal blurb for sales/SEs: "We reverted eu-central to v2.9.7 after observing increased token usage with v2.9.8. No customer-visible failures; we are evaluating cost delta and will follow up within the 2-hour postmortem." Add the billing contact and status link.
Liam O'Connor: Release-coordinator-bot: mark change window as impacted and add rollback tag to release notes?
release-coordinator-bot: MARK: change-window 00:30-01:30 impacted=true. Append tag: rollback_eu_2.9.8. Notifying oncall and account-ops.
Ravi Kumar: running dry-run now.
Ravi Kumar: dry-run clean. executing traffic shift at 6321112455.
release-coordinator-bot: TRAFFIC SHIFT: eu-central traffic shifted to 2.9.7 at 6321112455. pinned for safety.
Evelyn Park: monitoring: tokens/sec trending down; p50 recovering to baseline in 4m.
deploy-bot: NOTE: auto-rollback policy will resume after pinned period expires (pinned=true). Manual unpin required to reattempt rollout.
Liam O'Connor: next steps: Evelyn to open postmortem ticket outlining quantization config change, Ravi to prepare patch that makes quantization opt-in, and I'll notify dedicated accounts with >$10k/mo exposure.
Ravi Kumar: also update release notes: add a short paragraph under Known Issues and list which tenants were affected by EU pin.
Evelyn Park: drafting customer email now; will include timeline, mitigation, and support contact.
Liam O'Connor: thanks. We'll schedule a 30-min sync in 45m to review postmortem draft. :calendar:
